text:
Cancer (Jun 22-Jul 22)
Daily Horoscope Prediction says, There’s a certain quietness to you today, but it’s not because anything has gone wrong. It’s more like you’re noticing things you usually move past. Small shifts. Small pauses. Small inconsistencies that don’t seem big enough to react to, but also don’t feel right enough to ignore. You might find yourself picking up on tone more than words. Someone says something normal, but it doesn’t sit the same. You don’t question it out loud. You don’t even fully analyse it. But it stays somewhere in your system. That’s how the day begins to unfold — not loudly, but with a kind of steady awareness that keeps building.
